role: Recognises whether the live workout GPS track follows a route saved in SavedRouteStore, in forward or reverse direction, by mean nearest-neighbour fit of a sampled live track to a thinned prefix of the saved track.
types: RouteLibrary: enum (@MainActor) — namespace for route-matching constants and geometry
RouteLibrary.Match: struct — matched SavedRoute, rebuilt Route, direction, mean fit metres
toplevel: Only static constants; no stored mutable state.

units.does: Returns the best (lowest mean-fit) Match among the store's saved routes for `sport` (forward and reverse candidates), or nil if the sport is unsupported, the track has <2 points, the live track is shorter than 500 m, or no candidate fits within 30 m.

branches.effect: resolve AppDependencies.current.location.savedRouteStore (SavedRouteStore.shared unless overridden); else use the passed store

branches.cond: sport in supportedSports and track has >=2 points
for each saved route of this sport (newest first)
for each candidate whose fit beats the current best

branches.effect: ?? uses +infinity when no best yet so the first candidate always wins; ties keep the earlier (newer route, forward before reverse)

flags.text: No test calls RouteLibrary.findMatch, scoreDirection, candidates, location(of:), evenSample or thinned (RouteLibraryGeometryTests covers only trackPrefix/meanNearestDistance/nearestDistance), so the reverse-direction climb queue and the start gate are unverified.

units.does: Converts a SavedRoute to a Route, rebuilds a CLLocation track from its trackpoints with each point's saved altitude (location(of:)), and returns up to two Matches: forward against the saved Route (with its enriched climbs) and reverse against a Route rebuilt by Route.fromGPX from the reversed track, whose climb detection now sees the real altitudes. Reverse climbs carry no road names (the library's geocoding pass names only forward climbs).
A saved Route.Point as a CLLocation carrying its latitude, longitude and altitudeMeters (accuracies 0, timestamp distantPast — unused by the distance and climb math).

Scores one direction: rejects when either track is empty or the saved start is more than startGateMeters (150 m) from the live start; otherwise takes the saved prefix of (live distance + prefixOvershootMeters, 200 m), thinned to prefixSpacingMeters (5 m), computes the mean nearest distance from up to maxScoredPoints (300) evenly sampled live points, and returns a Match when it is <= matchToleranceMeters (30 m).

branches.cond: both tracks have a first point
live start within startGateMeters of saved start
branches.effect: continue; otherwise nil (a workout started partway round a saved loop is not recognised, as documented on startGateMeters)

units.does: Returns `count` points evenly spaced by index across the track, or the track unchanged when count<=0 or the track is not longer than count.

branches.effect: subsample by index step track.count/count; otherwise return track as-is

units.does: Returns the track with points closer than `spacing` metres to the last kept point dropped; first and last points are always kept.

branches.cond: track has a first and last point
point at least `spacing` from last kept
branches.effect: append and make it last kept; else skip

branches.cond: last kept point is not the same object as the track's end (identity !==)
branches.effect: append the end point; otherwise already present

units.does: Returns the summed segment length of the track via WorkoutGeometry.trackLengthMeters.
Returns the leading points of the track up to and including the first point whose cumulative distance reaches `meters`; whole track when <2 points or meters<=0.

branches.effect: walk the track; otherwise return track unchanged
accumulate distance and append each point
stop; otherwise keep walking (whole track if never reached)

units.does: Mean over points of `a` of the nearest distance to any point in `b`; +infinity when either is empty.
Minimum CLLocation distance from `pa` to any point in `b`; greatestFiniteMagnitude for empty b.
